decision.observation: Back on the sand at the palm bases, stamina fully refilled (green). Red rock outcrops and boulders rise at right, palms behind, sea at left. A small snail icon and yellow arrow sit at the stamina bar's right end.
decision.hypothesis: The snail marker is probably a hunger/food indicator. The rock outcrops at right are climbable terrain heading inland toward the mountain.
decision.memory: Palm climbing drains stamina without height gain; rock is the better surface.
